question: For the station that had the highest number of Citibike trips starting there in 2018, which numeric day of the week and which hour of the day had the greatest number of trips based on the start time of those trips?
sql:
WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
trip_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.start_station_id,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM t.starttime) as day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.starttime) as hour_of_day,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station ts
  WHERE t.start_station_id = ts.start_station_id
    AND t.starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.start_station_id, day_of_week, hour_of_day
),
top_day AS (
  SELECT day_of_week, SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM trip_stats
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY total_trips DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_hour AS (
  SELECT hour_of_day, SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM trip_stats
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY total_trips DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM top_day d, top_hour h

WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
trip_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.start_station_id,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM t.starttime) as day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.starttime) as hour_of_day,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips` t, top_station ts
  WHERE t.start_station_id = ts.start_station_id
    AND t.starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.start_station_id, day_of_week, hour_of_day
),
top_day AS (
  SELECT day_of_week, SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM trip_stats
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY total_trips DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_hour AS (
  SELECT hour_of_day, SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM trip_stats
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY total_trips DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM top_day d, top_hour h
